package main

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/aws"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/dynamodb"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/sns"
)

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	var client *sns.Client
	topic := os.Getenv("ORDERS_TOPIC")
	client.Publish(ctx, &sns.PublishInput{TopicArn: new(topic)})
	client.Publish(ctx, &sns.PublishInput{TopicArn: new("arn:aws:sns:eu-west-1:111122223333:x")})
}
